description: Resource files: create any ClassDB resource as .tres, change one, write a shader, build a TileSet, or set a Theme colour or font size. A material is a create with resourceType StandardMaterial3D, ShaderMaterial or CanvasItemMaterial. Needs the editor connected. Operations: create (needs resourceType): a new resource of any class; modify (needs properties): set properties on an existing resource; create_shader (needs shaderType): a .gdshader file; create_tileset (needs sources): a TileSet from texture atlases; set_theme_color (needs controlType, colorName, color): a colour in a Theme; set_theme_font_size (needs controlType, fontSizeName, size): a font size in a Theme.

code.description: create_shader: the shader source. Default: a minimal shader of that type.

color.description: set_theme_color: r, g and b from 0 to 1, with a optional and opaque by default.

controlType.description: Theme ops: the Control class, such as "Button".

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

properties.description: Properties to set, keyed by Godot property name. Vectors, colours and the like may be written as {"x": 1, "y": 2} or tagged {"_type": "Vector2", "x": 1, "y": 2}, which is the form a read answers with, so a value read off one node can be written straight to another.

resourcePath.description: File inside the project, such as "sprites/hero.png" or "materials/steel.tres".

resourceType.description: create: the resource class, such as "PhysicsMaterial" or "StandardMaterial3D".

script.description: create: a script to attach, for custom resources.

texture.description: File inside the project, such as "sprites/hero.png" or "materials/steel.tres".

name: resource_edit
